reason.en: the supplied inventory has uncompensated ionic charge. This adapter interprets non-H/O element totals as an analytical component problem and adjusts pH to impose electroneutrality; H/O basis entries are conservation coordinates, not prescribed free-ion concentrations. A reported pH or speciation therefore describes that proton-compensated analytical problem, not a prediction for a complete physical mixture of these ions. Supply the actual counterions or use complete acid, base or salt reagents; no sodium, chloride or other counterion is inferred

cases.original_forecast: Cooling should favour potassium-nitrate crystallisation while the smaller sodium-chloride charge may remain largely in solution.

criteria.criterion: Calculate the KNO3-to-NaCl ratio in retained solids and compare with the feed.
Distinguish purity improvement from complete nitrate recovery.

limitations: All original salt remains dissolved after cooling to45.29875C; retained solid is empty, so purity and crystal recovery are undefined. This saved protocol is inconclusive for its predicted selectivecrystallisation. No unsupported claim that this proves an appbug or real mixed-salt saturation curve; source/property/domain inspection is separate.

cases.original_forecast: If both routes reach the same retained composition without different losses, their complete-route enthalpy balances should agree. Intermediate heat changes differ because hydration and neutralisation are separated in the second route.

criteria.criterion: Compare full-route energy ledgers from the same initial inputs, not only the final command increment.
Verify final phase and species inventories match before interpreting a Hess-law comparison.

criteria.criterion: Report the three measured conversion fractions and the engine’s stated combination rule.
All arms conserve catalyst and substrate-derived atoms; do not force an unsupported additive or multiplicative claim.

metrics.exact_source_combination_rule: Maximum effective active pathway strength, activity*exp(-Ea/RT), relative to uncatalysed baseline; no multiplication of catalyst factors.

Its formula is a placeholder — a protein is not a stoichiometric species here and never takes part in a mass balance; only its effect on the activation energy is modelled. Molar mass ~240 kDa (bovine liver catalase, standard reference)

limitations: Actualfractional conversions andexplicitmaxpathway rule are reported. Equal nearcompleteenzymearms do not identify interactionparameters.
